subject: PO onboarding constraints & invoice cadence — ClearPoint procurement
messages:
From: Jenna Park <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — ClearPoint is keen to move to PO-based purchasing for the Sandbox and Prod environments. Procurement has a couple of non-negotiable requirements we need confirmed before issuing the first PO: 

- Net terms: our default is Net60; any exceptions require finance approval.
- Invoice cadence: we require one invoice per legal entity per month (we cannot accept weekly batching).
- PO fields: every invoice must reference the ClearPoint PO number, our legal entity VAT/Tax ID, and the BU code in the invoice header.

I'm attaching our standard PO template (ClearPoint_PO_Template_v1.pdf). Two questions here for your billing/finance team:

1) Can Redwood issue separate invoices per BU/month while aggregating usage on your side for credits?
2) Do you have an early-pay discount option if we move to Net45 for strategic accounts?

If you can confirm by EOD Wednesday we'll start drafting the PO.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearPoint Health
procurement@clearpointhealth.com

--
Attachment: ClearPoint_PO_Template_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Jenna — thanks, and great to hear ClearPoint is ready to move forward. Looping in Vanessa (Acct Exec), Ben (Billing lead) and Karthik (Finance ops) so we can confirm specifics.

Quick answers and clarifying notes below: 

- Separate invoices per BU/month: Yes, we can generate distinct invoices by BU/legal entity. Our billing system supports monthly per-entity invoices; we will need the BU mapping sheet populated (provide BU code -> legal entity -> billing email).

- Aggregated usage for credits: Redwood can produce an internal consolidated usage report for account teams to calculate credits, but credits must be applied at invoice-level and tied to PO numbers. 

- PO fields: we can include PO number, Tax ID and BU code in the invoice header. Please confirm exact Tax ID string format and whether you need the remittance address printed or included as metadata.

- Net terms / early-pay: We typically price for Net30/Net45. Net60 is a longer term than our standard. We can offer an Early-Pay discount program as an exception for strategic customers — Ben, can you outline a proposed structure?

Proposed next steps: 
1) Jenna — share the completed BU mapping and preferred remittance address.
2) Ben/Karthik/V: I'll let you propose the simple concessions we can offer (early-pay discount, or milestone-linked credits) that don't erode unit economics.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

--
Attachment referenced: ClearPoint_PO_Template_v1.pdf

From: Jenna Park <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks for the quick response. A few clarifications from procurement and finance at ClearPoint: 

- BU mapping: attached is a small CSV with BU codes and legal entities (we'll upload the full sheet after contract signature). For now you can assume 3 legal entities: ClearPoint West (Tax ID: 98-7654321), ClearPoint East (Tax ID: 12-3456789), and CP Research (Tax ID: 33-2109876).

- Remittance address: Please print the following on invoices: 1200 Harbor Ln, Suite 200, Seattle, WA 98101. If remittance needs to be embedded in metadata, let us know the preferred field name.

- Net terms: our procurement policy requires Net60 for enterprise POs. Finance asks whether Redwood can tier discounts instead of changing term lengths (example: 2% if paid within 15 days). They asked specifically: would Redwood accept Net60 on contract but offer an optional early-pay discount to incentivize faster payment?

- Other must-have: invoice must include PO number on the first page header and be machine-readable (PDF text, not image).

We can issue a test PO once billing confirms format.

Regards,
Jenna Park
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearPoint Health

Attachment: BU_Mapping_preview.csv (text/csv, 3KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Jenna — Ben here (billing). Appreciate the BU mapping preview. We can meet the formatting and per-entity monthly invoice requirement. A couple of proposed tradeoffs that should satisfy procurement and protect our price structure: 

1) Contract term: Redwood is OK to accept Net60 on the contract-level PO for ClearPoint.

2) Early-pay discount option: we'll include an elective discount line item you can opt into on each invoice: 2% off invoice subtotal if payment is received within 15 days. This keeps Net60 as default but gives finance an incentive.

3) Consolidated credits/promo: We'll track usage consolidated but apply any credits or promotional adjustments on the next month's invoice per BU. Credits will be documented in a separate ledger CSV (we'll send Redwood_MultiPO_Options.xlsx) so your AR system can reconcile automatically.

4) Machine-readable invoices: agreed — PDFs will be text-searchable and include the PO number in the header and in metadata fields.

5) Implementation ask: we will need a sample PO once issued to validate parsing rules. Can ClearPoint send a test PO to billing@redwood.com (subject: "Test PO - CLP-XXXX")?

If this is acceptable, we'll prepare a short addendum to the order form documenting the early-pay elective discount and invoice fields. Vanessa — can you confirm commercial acceptance so I can draft the addendum?

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing & Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
